reference.product: Copernicus Global Flood Monitoring NRT v4.1.0

alignment.resampling: Nearest-neighbour sampling of each GFM value layer and validity mask onto the native NISAR grid; no NISAR raster is resampled.
alignment.common_valid_rule: All four sampled GFM layers (flood extent, likelihood, exclusion, reference water) must be valid.

accuracy_metrics.reason: GFM is an independent algorithmic satellite product, not field truth.

interpretation_limits: This is positive-only spatial support between native NISAR radar-change candidates and an independent Sentinel-1 GFM algorithm product.
It is not field validation, an accuracy assessment, precision, recall or F1.
GFM non-flood cells are not treated as ground-truth negatives; the sensors and algorithms differ.
NISAR/GFM no-data, GFM exclusion, and permanent/seasonal reference-water cells are not counted as negative labels.
The original public HLS optical reference remains INCONCLUSIVE; this comparison does not upgrade it.
The study box is the published operator-selected rectangle, not an authoritative flood or wetland boundary.
The comparison uses the reprocessed native NISAR grid; recovery is reprocessing, not restoration of the original TIFF bytes.
